description: Type definitions for calendar-related data structures, interfaces, and types used in a scheduling application, including calendar events, persons, team members, availability, and calendar service interactions.

classes.name: Calendar
classes.description: Interface defining methods for calendar operations such as creating, updating, deleting events, and fetching availability.

classes.name: CalendarServiceEvent
classes.description: Extends Calendar with additional description for calendar service events.

classes.name: IntegrationCalendar
classes.description: Represents a calendar integration with properties for display and credentials.

methods.name: getAvailability
methods.description: Fetches busy dates for given calendar parameters.
